items.title: Show HN: AI Pulse a fake LED strip beside the macOS Dock that shows agent status
items.why_it_matters: An indie developer built and shipped a lightweight macOS utility that displays a virtual LED strip next to your Dock to show when Claude Code is waiting on a permission prompt. It is a perfect example of shipping a simple, highly targeted tool to solve a real workflow bottleneck. This week, clone the repo, run it on your Mac, and use it to keep your Claude Code sessions moving while you work on AI-ingest.

items.title: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code
items.why_it_matters: Anthropic has made "auto mode" the default setting in Claude Code, meaning the tool will now execute multi-step command sequences and file edits without stopping to ask for your permission at every single turn. This significantly speeds up the vibe-coding loop by letting the AI run autonomously until it genuinely needs your high-level direction. This week, run your package manager's update command for Claude Code and use the new auto-mode default to scaffold your next AI-ingest feature in a single prompt.
